thread_title: S. leucophylla RED 'Breeder clone' Franklin Co, FL
breadcrumb: S. leucophylla RED 'Breeder clone' Franklin Co, FL

posts.body_html:
I'm pretty sure the name sums up this clone, but just in case it wasn't clear, this clone for sure has unique traits that make it worthy of breeding and further refining! There probably isn't any other clone in the collection with this much red stretching this far down the trap! Needless to say, the red is very well defined!

S. leucophylla RED 'Breeder Clone' Franklin Co, FL, pics taken 10/1/22:


Many curse words were yelled out when I first noticed this trap (holy F, mother Effin S, Ef me that's crazy red, J Effin C Almighty, etc), but my neighbors assured me that their kids "have heard it all" so there was no refraining from a plethora of derrogatory bouts of Joy seeing this for the first time!
